description: Calculate statistics over one column in a table. Use when needing summary statistics for a single column; NOT for multi-column analysis. Use 'convert_table' for transformations.
name: column_stats

avg.description: The average of the values in the specified column.

count.description: The number of values in the specified column.

distinct.description: The number of distinct values in the specified column.

max.description: The maximum value in the specified column.

min.description: The minimum value in the specified column.

sum.description: The sum of the values in the specified column.

title: Column stats
